title: Pictograms / Usage

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content area, default interactive state

slide_intent: Match a symbol’s expressive strength to its job so visual emphasis helps people rather than overwhelming them.
strategic_value: A distinction between productive and expressive pictograms can preserve IBM consistency across quiet interfaces and large communications.
demonstration: The page compares use contexts, sizes, containers and color themes, then shows pictograms in illustrations, signage and merchandise.
practical_value: Choose productive artwork for most contexts and reserve expressive artwork for a large, deliberate presence.

content_islands.name: Productive and expressive roles
content_islands.spec: Begin with contextual examples and explicit prohibitions on UI-icon substitution and logo lockups.

content_islands.name: Sizing and placement
content_islands.spec: Follow with size steps, optical alignment, accepted containers and clearance diagrams.

content_islands.name: Color and backgrounds
content_islands.spec: Compare accepted contrast with rejected tone and gradient combinations, then provide the four-theme lookup table.

content_islands.name: Illustration and physical applications
content_islands.spec: Finish with a constructed illustration, signage, event graphic, cap and digital use.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source explains that productive symbols support most contexts while expressive symbols create a strong presence.
reference_purposes.Expression: Pictograms vary from simple linework to layered gradient forms.
reference_purposes.Application: Examples show placement in interfaces, communication, signage and merchandise.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The guide sets a 48px minimum and quarter-grid padding; it prohibits using pictograms as logos or replacements for UI icons and limits expressive use.

ingredient.name: Productive and expressive pictograms
ingredient.role: Provide either quiet explanation or deliberate graphic emphasis.
ingredient.application: Use productive pictograms for most contexts. Use expressive pictograms selectively at sufficient size; match the background theme and preserve quarter-grid clearance.
ingredient.scope: These are illustrations, not UI icons or logos. The general minimum is 48px; use the expressive sizing specimen for its shown larger steps.
